source: Business Plus-U6.pdf, country comparison chart; answer key checked against Teacher’s Manual 1, printed page 32

questions.explanation: Thailand is smaller than Indonesia. / Indonesia is bigger than Thailand.

questions.statement: The population of Indonesia is the smallest.
questions.explanation: The population of Indonesia is the biggest. / The population of Singapore is the smallest.

questions.statement: Thailand is more crowded than Indonesia.
questions.explanation: Thailand has 140 people per sq km; Indonesia has 130.

questions.statement: The population of Singapore is younger than the population of Indonesia.
questions.explanation: The population of Singapore is older than the population of Indonesia. / The population of Indonesia is younger than the population of Singapore.

questions.statement: An apartment in Bangkok is cheaper than an apartment in Jakarta.
questions.explanation: An apartment in Bangkok is more expensive than an apartment in Jakarta. / An apartment in Jakarta is cheaper than an apartment in Bangkok.

questions.statement: The most expensive apartment is in Jakarta.
questions.explanation: The most expensive apartment is in Singapore.

questions.statement: The population of Thailand is the youngest.
questions.explanation: The population of Thailand is the oldest. / The population of Indonesia is the youngest.

questions.statement: The most crowded country is Singapore.
questions.explanation: Singapore has 7,800 people per sq km, the highest figure in the chart.
